gold_sql:
WITH origin AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-80.278335 36.136398)',4326) AS pt
),
nearby_tiles AS (
  SELECT d.rast
  FROM public.dem_us d, origin o
  WHERE d.rast && ST_Expand(o.pt, 1.0)
),
masked AS (
	  SELECT ST_MapAlgebra(
	           rast,
	           1,
	           '32BF'::text,
	           'CASE WHEN [rast.val] < 400 THEN [rast.val] ELSE NULL END'::text,
	           NULL::double precision
	         ) AS rast
  FROM nearby_tiles
),
qualifying_pixels AS (
  SELECT (pp).geom AS geom
  FROM masked
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL ST_PixelAsCentroids(rast, 1, TRUE) AS pp
)
SELECT MIN(ST_Distance(p.geom::geography, o.pt::geography)) AS distance_m
FROM qualifying_pixels p, origin o;

WITH target_poi AS (
  SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-80.278335, 36.136398), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
low_elevation_area AS (
  SELECT ST_Union(rast) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us
  WHERE ST_Intersects(rast, (SELECT geom FROM target_poi))
),
clipped_low_elevation AS (
  SELECT ST_Clip(
    rast,
    (SELECT geom FROM target_poi),
    true
  ) AS rast
  FROM low_elevation_area
),
nearest_point AS (
  SELECT ST_AsText(ST_ClosestPoint(
    (SELECT geom FROM target_poi),
    ST_Union(ST_PixelAsPoints(rast, 1))
  )) AS nearest_point_wkt
),
distance_result AS (
  SELECT ST_Distance(
    (SELECT geom FROM target_poi),
    ST_SetSRID(ST_GeomFromText(nearest_point_wkt), 4326)::geography
  ) AS distance_meters
  FROM nearest_point
)
SELECT ROUND(distance_meters) AS distance_to_low_elevation_meters
FROM distance_result;
